note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958 in one division, Crumlin. The district had 25 divisions. Twenty-four are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (Charles K. Holden, returning officer, The Steeple, Antrim, dated 6 June 1958; Ballymena Observer, 13 June 1958, p. 2): Crumlin was polled and the other 23 had sole candidates, declared elected. In Antrim Urban one of the two candidates, William Burrowes, died on 4 June, the eve of the poll; the notice enters 'Deceased' and no return was made, so that division's fresh election is not part of this round and is not yet found. No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. Returned unopposed.
